title: Simple Hotbar Switcher
description: switch inventory and hotbar with one button
body:
## 🌟 **Overview**
SimpleHotbarSwitcher is a Fabric mod that introduces efficient hotbar management. By moving the logic to the server, it ensures perfect synchronization, zero "ghost items," and a seamless experience for all players.

## 🛠 Features

- Single Slot Swap: Use Alt + [1-9] to instantly swap a hotbar slot with the inventory slot above it.
 
- Full Row Exchange: Use Alt + 0 to swap the entire hotbar with the closest to hotbar row of your inventory.
 
- Low Latency: Optimized packet handling ensures that swaps feel instantaneous even with moderate ping.
 
- Working better at server-side mode, at only client-side сan create ghost items

## 🎮 How to Use
1. Install on Server: Drop the .jar into your server's mods folder.
 
2. Install on Client: For the best experience it is recommended to have the mod on the client side as well.

### Default Keys:

> Hold Left Alt + 1-9: Swap specific slot.

> Hold Left Alt + 0: Swap entire bar.

**REQIRING FABRIC API (0.141.3+1.21.11)**
